bundle.longDescription: DOLLY captures a display, window, or region and turns cursor telemetry into automatic, editable zoom segments, exporting polished MP4s entirely on-device.

macOS._comment_signingIdentity: Injected in CI from the Developer ID Application cert (BUILD_PLAN §8). Sign the sidecar first, then the app — `codesign --deep` is unreliable. Left null so local dev builds run unsigned.
macOS._comment_hardenedRuntime: Hardened runtime is enabled automatically by Tauri when a signingIdentity is present; entitlements.plist below carries the required exceptions (audio-input, JIT). No app-sandbox for v1 (§8).

updater._comment_endpoints: PLACEHOLDER static JSON manifest endpoint (BUILD_PLAN §8). Real host + signed manifest wired in CI.
updater._comment_pubkey: PLACEHOLDER minisign public key (base64). Generated once with `tauri signer generate`; the matching private key is a CI secret used to sign each release's manifest (§8).
